title: When Does Dynamic Ensembling Pay Off? Diagnosing Regionwise Gains in Regression under Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2608.18330v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whether input-dependent ("dynamic") combination of a regression model pool beats the best static blend depends on the shift and is rarely known before deployment. Can a small labeled target-domain probe tell us when reallocating trust across regions of the input space will pay off? We answer this with $\widehat{D}_{\mathrm{CF5}}$, which estimates from the probe the cross-fitted gain of the regionwise convex combination over the best static convex blend: the realizable value of deciding, region by region, whom to trust. Across a frozen suite of 12 dataset-shift pairs (spatial, temporal, domain, feature-cluster), $\widehat{D}_{\mathrm{CF5}}$ predicts realized regionwise test gains with dataset-level Spearman $+0.98$ (95% CI $[+0.83, +1.00]$; $p=5\times10^{-5}$), including two cases overturning preregistered expectations. The relationship holds in a 16-pair sensitivity analysis (Spearman $+0.83$), whereas alternative probe diagnostics reach

translated_title: 动态集成何时有效？分布偏移下回归中区域增益的诊断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18330v1 公告类型：新 摘要：回归模型池的输入依赖（“动态”）组合是否优于最佳静态混合，取决于偏移情况，且通常在部署前难以知晓。一个小的带标签目标域探针能否告诉我们，在输入空间的各个区域重新分配信任何时会带来收益？我们通过 $\widehat{D}_{\mathrm{CF5}}$ 回答了这个问题，它从探针中估计区域凸组合相对于最佳静态凸组合的交叉拟合增益：即逐区域决定信任谁的可实现价值。在冻结的12个数据集-偏移对（空间、时间、域、特征聚类）套件中，$\widehat{D}_{\mathrm{CF5}}$ 预测实现的区域测试增益，数据集级别Spearman相关系数为+0.98（95%置信区间 $[+0.83, +1.00]$；$p=5\times10^{-5}$），包括两个推翻预注册预期的案例。该关系在16对敏感性分析中成立（Spearman +0.83），而替代探针诊断则无法达到此效果。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于小目标域探针的估计器 $\widehat{D}_{\mathrm{CF5}}$，能高精度预测动态集成在分布偏移下的区域增益，从而判断何时动态组合优于静态混合。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an estimator $\widehat{D}_{\mathrm{CF5}}$ based on a small target-domain probe that accurately predicts regionwise gains of dynamic ensembling under distribution shift, determining when dynamic combination outperforms static blending.
